result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed multi-lane arterial road with a separated pedestrian path located behind a chain-link fence. While the path provides physical separation from vehicles, the environment is highly hostile to pedestrians due to the lack of crossing infrastructure and the high-speed design of the roadway.

hazards.name: High-speed vehicle traffic
hazards.description: The wide, multi-lane roadway design encourages high vehicle speeds adjacent to the pedestrian path.

hazards.description: The width of the road creates a significant barrier for pedestrians with no visible safe crossing points.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the entire width of the roadway.

hazards.name: Physical entrapment
hazards.description: The continuous chain-link fence prevents pedestrians from exiting the path to the roadway or vice versa in an emergency.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image, running parallel to the road.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and provide space for improved pedestrian and cycling infrastructure.

interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide road in stages.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK)
interventions.description: Install a signalized crossing to provide a protected interval for pedestrians to cross this high-speed arterial.

The road edge is cluttered with debris and overgrown vegetation, creating a hostile environment for pedestrians.
